subject: Error loading package aws.signature on shinyapps.io

messages.author: 9a8e0c0e0f8a18c7
messages.subject: Error loading package aws.signature on shinyapps.io
parts:
Dear All,
I am trying to make a shiny app with data stored in an Amazon S3 bucket on shinyapps.io. I'm attempting to use the aws.s3 and aws.signature packages. The former loads with no problem from github, using
devtools::install_github("cloudyr/aws.signature")
 whereas the latter fails, leading to a "disconnected from the server" error. The logs shows the source of the problem.
2017-03-24T09:41:06.196244+00:00 shinyapps[166700]: Error: ERROR: no permission to install to directory ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
This is odd, since I can load other packages, including from github, without problems. I also can run this example locally with no problem. I have posted a minimal example at https://paine.shinyapps.io/trial/.
Any suggestions or advice would be welcome.

The full log output, server.R and ui.R files follow.

Thanks, and best wishes,
--tim

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error loading package aws.signature on shinyapps.io
parts: The devtools::install_github should not be in the application itself. Run it in order to install the packages locally, and then declare them in your application with library calls instead.
On Fri, Mar 24, 2017 at 5:51 AM C. E. Timothy Paine <cetp...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dear All,
I am trying to make a shiny app with data stored in an Amazon S3 bucket on shinyapps.io. I'm attempting to use the aws.s3 and aws.signature packages. The former loads with no problem from github, using
devtools::install_github("cloudyr/aws.signature")
 whereas the latter fails, leading to a "disconnected from the server" error. The logs shows the source of the problem.
2017-03-24T09:41:06.196244+00:00 shinyapps[166700]: Error: ERROR: no permission to install to directory ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
This is odd, since I can load other packages, including from github, without problems. I also can run this example locally with no problem. I have posted a minimal example at https://paine.shinyapps.io/trial/.
Any suggestions or advice would be welcome.

The full log output, server.R and ui.R files follow.

Thanks, and best wishes,
--tim
